snippet.title: Robot Resources - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Cleo, a feline overworked recruiter, is circling the drain after spending several nights at the office keeping up with work. Between nightmares, demanding work, and the threat of a new GenAI system taking over her job, how is a cat supposed to live her best life?!

The art direction is somewhere between early Game Boy and LCD handheld games (e.g., Game & Watch, Tiger Electronics).

Available now on Itch.io:
https://edwin-at-work.itch.io/robot-resources

Credits:
Editor: @KurffyOfficial 
Voice Over: Soulia Sora (https://souliasora.carrd.co/)
Audio: @OwenCat1512 ​
